summary: The PR adds the `store_cv_values` parameter to `RidgeClassifierCV`, but it does not address the underlying issue of the parameter not being used correctly.

issues.description: The PR does not implement the functionality to store cross-validation values when `store_cv_values` is set to `True`. The parameter is added to the constructor, but the actual logic to store the values is missing.

The PR lacks tests to verify that the `store_cv_values` parameter works as expected. There should be unit tests to ensure that the cross-validation values are stored correctly when the parameter is set to `True`.
